x: All our walkers may be said to have done well, but a special word of praise must go to W. Holman for his very fine showing in his first race.
A special word of commendation must be given to W. Holman, who, in his first season of walking, finished 59th in 3 hrs. 6 min. 48 sec.—an excellent performance.
W. Holman also deserves an "honourable mention" upon finishing sixth in the "Guildford Cup" 50 kilometres walk.
W. Holman was responsible for a very creditable performance in finishing 15th in excellent time; and Paul Khlopin again showed his reliability in finishing just outside 9½hours.
Altogether 16 finished of the 18 starters. As was to be expected by their fast times, Rickards and Green took handicap awards, the other prize, as mentioned above, going to W.
Penney; late of Upcorne Road, and who joined the Navy. W.
